notes.title: Dev Talk #2 - Do you seek for power?
notes.notes:
Dear fellow colleagues,

Welcome to Quit Today's Dev Blog, again🙂
Quit Today is a 2D side-scrolling beat 'em-up game, with an absurd but seemingly logical storyline that people may face day by day in their careers (｡･∀･)ﾉﾞ

As players, the desire to become stronger in the game is natural. On one hand, it's expected that as the game progresses, stronger enemies will appear. On the other hand, it's just enjoyable to play the game like a pro when your abilities are enhanced!

In this Deb blog, we would like to talk about the design of power growth in "Quit Today" and how we keep the creative momentum flowing during the game development process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967093/b3bd1ae278d98f5bac9f51693df39823a0b5e8af.png[/img]

[h2][b]🏢 The Longer You Stay in the Workplace, the More You Learn Survival Skills![/b][/h2]

Although there are often troubles in the company that make people feel uncomfortable and fed up, it cannot be denied that long-term workplace experience accumulates a lot of wisdom, enhancing our judgment in unexpected situations.

Being immersed in the workplace for a long time, we no longer feel as clueless as when we first entered. We understand our labor rights and realize that things we can't stand may not be due to our incompetence but could be inherently unreasonable!

Working in the office also help acquire various job skills over time, allowing us to find shortcuts to complete tasks faster and better.

What initially took a long time to accomplish can be quickly linked to various resources and shortcuts related to the task, making you adept at handling these processes you're already familiar with.

✨ Gaining power in the workplace makes it easier to survive the battles! ✨

We hope "Quit Today" is a game that looks fun but also relates to everyone's experiences.

[h2][b]🤘 How to Gain the Power of Creation[/b][/h2]

Creators are not born with the ability to imagine and create content out of thin air. Inspiration is also inspired by experiences encountered in life. To avoid depleting imagination, it's crucial for us to carefully experience life and plan time to appreciate other creative works (games, comics, animation, movies, novels, etc.). Both are essential for finding inspiration.

So, we can often boldly declar: "✨ I'm working right now! ✨" while playing games!

Even if the inspiration fragments are similar, each creator's unique perspective and creative approach add magic to these fragments, creating works with distinctive personal styles.

Because works are based on experience and existing knowledge, even if we don't deliberately reference, there may inevitably be some designs in the work that others have done. Sometimes, when we see a game using similar methods, we can't help but cheer for them, hoping they all do well together!

[h2][b]🎅 Hoping for the Blessing of the Gaming Deity![/b][/h2]

Game development is a patient process. Our team, with one person in charge of executing the development plan, art, and programming, and another person in charge of non-development tasks, requires the developer to repeat testing the same actions many times (as for why testing many times, I'll write another piece to explain).

During late-night rushes, repeatedly testing the game can lead to falling asleep. At such times, we hope for a sudden burst of wisdom from above, allowing the game to be designed perfectly in one go, without the need for modifications and repeated confirmation of functions. Or we wish we could sleep with peace of mind, and little elves would finish the game for us the next morning 🤣

[h2]We currently offer a [u]demo[/u]. Feel free to try it out 👇[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858450/QUIT_TODAY/

If you enjoy it, please don’t hesitate to add to your wishlist! 👏
Let us know you've received our love and help us gain visibility ❤️

Thank you for reading, and we wish you a wonderful day! 🌻
See you next time! 👋

notes.title: Dev Blog #1 - Welcome to Quit Today
notes.notes:
Hello fellow colleagues,

Welcome to Quit Today's Dev Blog. 🙂
Here we would like to share updates of our latest developing game, Quit Today. 
Quit Today is a 2D side-scrolling beat 'em-up game, with an absurd but seemingly logical storyline that people may face day by day in their careers. 💻🤦

In case you haven't seen our trailer, here it is: 👇
[previewyoutube=ydzOIX4Fjtk;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2][b]🤷 Why Quit Today?[/b][/h2]

We were full-time employees where we stumbled on some... occasions that weren't so pleasant. 🤕
And happen to know a lot of our friends or colleagues stumble too.
Seeing that so many unpleasant occasions happen, we decided to make a game to show how we feel.
Adding in some humor since it is still a game. 🤭

If you ever feel down in your career, we hope this is the game that cheers you up. 💪💪

[h2][b]🙋 What we would like to offer in Quit Today?[/b][/h2]

[h3]Packed beat 'em-up action with Rogue-like element to make every run fun💥[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967093/c307bf1e6fe8b1c8c0ece573d3a034bb9df7e437.gif[/img]
In every workplace, every skill has an important meaning. 
We want to demonstrate this concept by producing various skills in-game. 

[h3]Immersive storyline based on day-to-day career life☕[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967093/26a7626f82183d9b01543f750c181349cdf11214.gif[/img]
Other than encountering occasions, sometimes we need to make choices in life. 
We want to express there is no right or wrong choice, it is just what you want. 
And most of the time, things are not as worst as you think. 

[h3]Partner system, fight with your close friends at work and feel supported🤜🤛[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967093/fe521c346c26a72de26d7b463e728403a43ee5ef.gif[/img]
Challenges can be hard in your career. 
In real life, when you have a group of friends at work, difficult challenges can be filled with laughter. 
We want to bring this concept to the game as well. You are not alone. 

[h3]Smooth combat experience with all hand-drawn visuals🖌️[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41967093/a48b4b1e6420b26a56d7e49a422f28ec1c69c39c.gif[/img]
The character design and art assets are all hand-drawn by our artist. 
We hope you will like them. ❤️

[h3]We have a [u]demo[/u] available, please feel free to try it here: 👇[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858450/QUIT_TODAY/

If you like what you see or play, please consider adding our game to your wishlist. 👏
Let us know how much interest there is, and help our game gain visibility. ❤️

Thank you for reading, enjoy the rest of your day! 🌻
Until next time! 👋

Play as an employee and enter the world of "Quit Today," a 2D side-scrolling action game that plunges you into an epic office battle. Your colleagues are after you because they believe you're resigning - and it's up to you to fight your way through the chaos to understand what is going on.

notes.notes:
[b]In celebration of the workplace beat 'em up title Quit Today being chosen for the Indie Game Selected Exhibit at TOKYO GAME SHOW 2022, YOHCAN Co., Ltd. from Taiwan is excited to announce the revamped Quit Today demo reveal during TGS![/b]

According to the developer, the demo will feature improved music and sound effects created by TPOP Studio, "The Interpreter of the Multitudes of Hearing", which previous works include the soundtracks for Robolife -Days with Aino, Fight of Animals, Legend of Mortal, etc. The to-be-released new Quit Today theme song, together with the newly designed 3D scene for the game is going to offer an exhilarating beat ‘em up experience!

The new Quit Today demo will be available to both online and offline players. In addition to Steam, the demo will also be available at the YOHCAN booth in the Indie Game Selected Exhibit at Makuhari Messe, Japan, during TOKYO GAME SHOW (from September 15 to September 18), so everyone can get their hands on early!

Time to quit your job and beat up on your co-workers!


🎮[b]“Quit Today” Steam Free Demo[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1858450/QUIT_TODAY/

"Quit Today" is participating in The Nightmarket Festival 2022, and is showcasing a time-limited demo until Aug 8 10am PST!

The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is showcasing around 100 discounted games, and offering free demos for dozens of hot upcoming titles!
The sale runs from Aug 4-8 10am PST. And includes live broadcasts to celebrate and showcase the lineup. [convert to time zones suitable for your followers]
The Nightmarket Festival 2022 is the first-ever Steam sales event focusing on promoting games from the SEA region, breaking cultural barriers, and raising awareness for the region’s gaming scene. We introduce awesome games with a local touch, just like the night market culture commonly seen here -- filled with creativity, diversity, and great fun.
